name: Ookami Shoujo to Issho Christmas Special Edition
original_name: 狼少女といっしょクリスマス特別版
source:
On a full moon of chrismas, you come back of work,
and you have a cute werewolf for greeting your welcome in Santa clothes !

Eating together, bathing together, rompy naughty things together... it's a life of romance!
We also have our quarrels but, she's ever so perky!
That Xmas night will be full of presents!

Side story available for free on [url=http://seismicxcharge.com/blog/2016/12/26/%E3%80%8E%E7%8B%BC%E5%B0%91%E5%A5%B3%E3%81%A8%E3%81%84%E3%81%A3%E3%81%97%E3%82%87%E3%80%8F-%E3%82%AF%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B9%E3%83%9E%E3%82%B9%E7%89%B9%E5%88%A5%E7%89%88-%E9%85%8D%E5%B8%83%E4%B8%AD/]Seismic[/url]'s blog.
translation:
在圣诞节满月的时候，你下班回来，
还有一只可爱的狼人穿着圣诞老人的衣服迎接你的到来！

一起吃饭，一起洗澡，一起嬉戏调皮……这就是浪漫的生活！
我们也有吵架的时候，但她却很活泼！
那个圣诞之夜将充满礼物！
